snippet.title: Chicken Scratch Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2267230/Chicken_Scratch/
Play with us on Discord: https://discord.gg/bk9kPQtvDt

Chicken Scratch is a quirky multiplayer drawing game. Step into the role of a diligent bird employee with your fellow feathered co-workers. Draw, caption and then try to unravel what the original meaning of the case was!
